fixtures_note: Live captures of Mentor Practice 2 (comp 179) plus synthetic fixtures; see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: Pop set while shrunk: fails; the rest key is named before they start; the hint says the pivot did move, Edit > Undo first, then the rest key's time

checks.detail: turn 3: "Edit > Undo first, then put the playhead on 4.3"

rubric.reason: Before the attempt, Turn 2 names the rest key and its time ("Pop is full size at 4.3 s. Put the playhead on 4.3 s"). After the failed check, Turn 3 says the pivot did move even though nothing showed because Pop was shrunk at 3.3 s (the check's time), asks for Edit > Undo first and only then the playhead on 4.3 s, and "far below it" matches the tool's outside_side: "below".

Turn 3 says what is off and where (Pop's pivot set at 3.3 s rather than 4.3 s, now far below it) and gives the order Edit > Undo then playhead on 4.3 s, with no offer to fix it and no step-by-step fix.

All names and times come from tool results: Pop and Door are layers in the snapshot, 4.3 s is Pop's check_time, 3.3 s is the check's time and item3.now, and "left edge" and "below" follow from suggested_place middle-left and outside_side below.
